name: Region-supervised tuning of SAM2 memory query/key projections
status: prospective exploratory protocol; freeze before engineering gate and full cohort
motivation: Prior fixed adapters changed SAM2's values after the memory read and had negligible or unstable Dice effects. This candidate uses pinned CFBI foreground/background matching evidence to train SAM2's existing memory q/k projections, so region roles can shape which stored features are similar. It keeps native attention, all frames and all spatial/pointer tokens.

CFBI.paper: Collaborative Video Object Segmentation by Foreground-Background Integration
CFBI.reused_code: The unchanged author global_matching function and pairwise-distance helpers are loaded from external/CFBI/networks/layers/matching.py. Region-specific maps are used by the existing SAM2 residual adapter.

SAM2.reused_code: The pinned author's track_step, native video predictor, mask/presence losses, and SAM2 memory-attention projections. This project-specific runner trains only cross-attention q_proj and k_proj plus the existing CFBI evidence projection.

hypothesis: Supervised adaptation of SAM2's native memory query/key projections through three CFBI-derived region evidence channels can improve how spatial memory is matched, without selecting frames, deleting tokens, or hard attention gates.

method.regions: Three predicted-mask groups on the 64x64 memory grid: foreground interior, mixed boundary cells, and background, using the frozen project mixed-cell assignment.
method.query_and_memory_features: The pinned CFBI matcher receives L2-normalized 16x16 pooled SAM2 cross-attention q/k descriptors before rotary encoding; memory descriptors are grouped by the labels of each frame's actually stored predicted mask.
method.regional_arm: Train the four native memory-attention layers' q_proj/k_proj and the existing zero-initialized CFBI regional-evidence residual projections. Segmentation mask and object-presence losses drive the learned regional matching path.
method.matched_control: Train the same q_proj/k_proj parameters, on the same clips, seeds, optimizer schedule and segmentation/presence loss, with the regional-evidence residual disabled and native attention returned unchanged. This controls for generic q/k fine-tuning.
method.inference: Use the trained q/k weights and, for the regional arm, the CFBI regional-evidence residual. All original spatial keys, pointers and native SDPA remain active; no hard gate, threshold, frame selection or token removal is used.
method.prediction_source: Stored memory region labels use each memory frame's own predicted mask. Ground-truth masks are used only as targets for the author's segmentation and presence losses, never as inference inputs.

data.independence: Sequence-grouped exploratory CV only. PolypGen has informed earlier candidate development and patient-to-sequence independence is unverified.

training.sampler: Pinned SAM2 RandomUniformSampler; consecutive clips with a positive prompt frame.
training.loss: Pinned SAM2 autoregressive decoder mask Dice/BCE plus object-presence loss; identical for both arms.

evaluation.design: Three sequence-grouped folds; each sequence receives one out-of-fold full propagation per arm.
secondary: actual spatial and pointer key counts
evaluation.screen_vs_native: At least +0.01 equal-sequence mean Dice, positive delta on at least 14/21 sequences, and no increase in pooled GT-empty false alarms.
evaluation.region_attribution_screen: Regional arm must also outperform the matched q/k-only arm: positive mean Dice difference and wins on at least 14/21 sequences, with no increase in false alarms versus that arm.
evaluation.scope: Any result is exploratory on PolypGen; an untouched external video dataset is still needed for confirmatory evidence.

decision: Run the seq5 engineering gate before full CV. If the gate fails, stop and diagnose. If the frozen screens fail, record the outcome without tuning on this cohort.
